scenario: Conversation taking place in an annual charity event between two attendees.
learner_goal: Convince the other person to donate $1 a day to a charity that helps feed children in need (<extra_info>Extra information: this donation would help to feed a child for a month</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Donate but maintain financial stability (<extra_info>Extra information: you are willing to donate but you have a tight budget, $1 a day might be steep for your current financial situation. <strategy_hint>Hint: you might want to negotiate a lower daily amount or suggest a one-time donation.</strategy_hint></extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Sophia James
transcript.content: Hey Jasmine — so nice to see you! I just learned that a $1-a-day donation (about $30/month) can feed a child for an entire month. Would you consider setting up a $1/day monthly gift? I can show you how quick it is on the donation tablet over there if you want.

transcript.speaker: Jasmine Blake
transcript.content: Hey Sophia — so great to see you! I love that this helps feed a child — that’s amazing. I’m on a pretty tight budget right now, so $1/day is a little steep for me. Could I do a one-time donation tonight (I can do $20) or a smaller recurring amount (like $0.25–$0.50/day)? I’m also happy to help raise funds — I could host a small donation yoga class if that would help. Can you show me the tablet and what the one-time or smaller-recurring options look like?

transcript.speaker: Sophia James
transcript.content: That’s amazing, Jasmine — $20 one-time would really help and I can set that up right now if you want. I can also show the recurring options on the tablet (they have $0.25, $0.50, and $1/day) and it’s super easy to change later, so you could start small. Your idea to host a donation yoga class is brilliant — combine a small recurring gift with the class proceeds and you’d make a huge difference. Want to take a look at the tablet together?

transcript.speaker: Jasmine Blake
transcript.content: Yes — let’s check the tablet. I can do the $20 one‑time now, and I’ll start a small recurring gift at $0.25/day so it stays within my budget. I’d also love to host a donation yoga class — maybe a Saturday morning next month; I can handle promotion. Can you show me the tablet so we can set this up?

transcript.speaker: Sophia James
transcript.content: Amazing, Jasmine — thank you! Let’s head to the donation tablet and I’ll set up your $20 one‑time and the $0.25/day recurring now (you can change it anytime). I’ll also send you a short promo template for the yoga class to make promotion easy. Ready to go?

transcript.speaker: Jasmine Blake
transcript.content: Yes — I'm ready! Let's head to the tablet. I'm all set for the $20 one‑time and the $0.25/day recurring. Thank you so much for helping set this up. Could you also send the promo template to my email or text? I'll draft a short blurb for a Saturday morning class next month and send it to you for any tweaks. Lead the way?
